name: MGM Grand Hotel & Casino
insider_take: This emerald giant isn't just big—it's a city within a city where entertainment legends are born and Vegas magic happens 24/7.
whats_special: The MGM Grand is one of the largest hotels in the world with over 5,000 rooms, featuring the iconic 45-foot bronze lion statue that weighs 50 tons. It's home to world-class entertainment venues including the Grand Garden Arena where boxing legends like Tyson and Mayweather made history, plus Cirque du Soleil's "KÀ" with its revolutionary rotating stage.
pro_tip: Book dinner reservations at least 48 hours in advance—celebrity chef restaurants like Emeril's New Orleans Fish House fill up quickly, especially during fight weekends and major conventions.
dont_miss: The Rainforest Cafe with its animatronic animals and thunderstorms, the CBS Television City Research Center where you can preview upcoming shows, and the SkyLoft penthouses—some of Vegas's most exclusive accommodations with private elevators and butler service.
pros: Prime Las Vegas Strip location with direct access to world-class entertainment
Extensive dining options with celebrity chef restaurants and diverse cuisines
Multiple pools, spa facilities, and comprehensive resort amenities
Full-service casino with gaming options and live entertainment venues
cons: Large resort size can require significant walking distances
Casino environment with smoking areas throughout property
